definitions.scope: Prospective local definition freeze after public accepted-event aggregates, before new bridge extraction. Two previously failed scenes, complete525+900 frames, two archived trials per arm/eight histories. No new source, independent confirmation or external preregistration.
definitions.anchor: At frame f use ONLY original accepted input keys (t,original detection index) common to both arms with t<f. Incremental prefix intersection, never full-sequence hindsight. Birth seeds, unmatched inputs, single-arm updates, current-frame high/weak updates and future observations cannot anchor. Whole-frame barrier is deliberately stricter than per-stage availability. All accepted high/weak and tentative/confirmed observations qualify equally; no fitted support threshold.
definitions.ownership: Vertices are per-arm immutable birth(frame,index) keys; equal labels across arms alone are no evidence. Native tokens recover ownership only within one arm; never cross-arm joins. Edge(r,c) exists iff at least one common accepted past observation belongs to those owners. Preserve all edges/support counts forever in this descriptive history graph, including retired lineages; no temporal decay, role eligibility or intervention. A transitive path alone is not a direct bridge.
definitions.categories: Exclusive priority: direct edge and degrees1/1=unique_continuation;1/>1=merge_relation (multiple reference owners to control);>1/1=split_relation;>1/>1=many_to_many_relation. No direct edge: both positive degrees=unbridged_known_chains; reference degree0 only=missing_reference_support; control degree0 only=missing_control_support; both0=missing_both_support. Indirect connectivity, empty accepted history vs only noncommon history are separate flags. Merge/split describes observation-chain ownership, not true physical identity.
definitions.denominators: Classify every common accepted input before committing any current anchors. Separately aggregate all_common, changed_lineage, unchanged_lineage and lost_original_active keys. Preserve all8 categories including zeros, per-group distinct owner-pair first-event categories, stage and predecision active/retained x tentative/confirmed strata. Denominators overlap explicitly; do not sum groups as independent cases. Lost-active includes original current owner/stage/role proxy semantics, never redefines its gate.
definitions.integrity: Reuse immutable AcceptedLedger validation. Read only eight compressed histories and pinned GT-free public records; stream every dense frame. Match complete original input/event receipts and original compare() memberships to previous report; raw JSONL and its digest local. Both archived trials independently analyzed, require exact summaries/ordered receipts. Recheck434 original byte hashes and all old source pins before/after. Pickles hash only; never load. No GT/media/cache/evaluator/solver/inference/tracker reads or execution.
definitions.failure: No overwrite, retry, imputation or source selection by outcome. Any inconsistent source failed with null bridge and local exception; keep26-row scope ledger, four old KITTI failures/nulls, out-of-scope counts null, incomplete discovery and eight false replication flags. Repeat trials add no independent evidence.
definitions.decision: Descriptive diagnosis only, no tuning/intervention/default or weak-stage change. Original two failed proxies remain failed regardless of bridge result. Chains are not physical identities: no FN/FP/IDSW/HOTA, merge correctness or true-harm acceptance. Missing evidence stays unknown. Choose further prospective diagnosis only after seeing complete frozen outcomes.
definitions.publication: Public source-level aggregate counts, denominators, role/stage strata and hashes only. Per-frame keys, owners, IDs, boxes, histories, cases, exceptions and local paths remain ignored local artifacts. Inherit reviewed MOT/KITTI noncommercial research terms; no raw media/GT/results redistribution.
